subject: Avoid drawing lines inside of shapes?

messages.author: bf5c9db520029459
messages.subject: Avoid drawing lines inside of shapes?
parts:
Hello,

in reference to the once proposed linewidth setting, I encountered a
problem while modifying sizes in point and line. The code at the
bottom shows my problem. As I have a big number of data points in one
plot, I would like to modify both, the size of of the points (lattice
cex) and the width of the line (lwd).

x <-
matrix(nrow=3,ncol=4,dimnames=list(c(),c("Price","Time","ID","Cond")))
x[1,] <- c(1,"2009-12-17","2","New")
x[2,] <- c(1,"2009-12-18","2","New")
x[3,] <- c(2,"2009-12-18","3","Old")
x <- data.frame(x)

colorlist <- c("New" = "black", "Old" = "khaki4")

p <- ggplot(x, aes(x=Time, y=Price, group=ID)) +
scale_colour_manual(values=colorlist)
+
geom_point(aes(shape=16, colour=Cond, size=1.2))

# something happens, I do not understand
print(p + geom_line(aes(colour=Cond, size=0.2)))

# allright, however, I would like to modify linewidth to a fixed value
print(p + geom_line(aes(colour=Cond)))


It would be great, if there would be an option in the theme section of
ggplot to get it out of the code as well.

Thank you
jorgusch

messages.subject: RE: Avoid drawing lines inside of shapes?
parts:
Hi Jorqusch,

I think you should not include size or shape as aesthetics (does the code
bellow produce the output you desire?). You can include a variable to map
sizes that will result in different line and point sizes automatically,
manually or by the values of the variable (e.g. scale_size,
scale_size_manual or scale_size_identity)

Hope this helps,
fernando

x <-
matrix(nrow=3,ncol=4,dimnames=list(c(),c("Price","Time","ID","Cond")))
x[1,] <- c(1,"2009-12-17","2","New")
x[2,] <- c(1,"2009-12-18","2","New")
x[3,] <- c(2,"2009-12-18","3","Old")
x <- data.frame(x)
colorlist <- c("New" = "black", "Old" = "khaki4")

p <- ggplot(x, aes(x=Time, y=Price, group=ID)) +
scale_colour_manual(values=colorlist)+
geom_point(aes(colour=Cond), size=3, shape=16)
# something happens, I do not understand
print(p + geom_line(aes(colour=Cond), size=1))

# allright, however, I would like to modify linewidth to a fixed value
print(p + geom_line(aes(colour=Cond)))
